hadith.chapterTitle: The Excellence of the Remembrance of Allah
hadith.body:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "When anyone of you has done his Tashahhud during Salat (prayer), he should seek refuge in Allah against four things and say: "Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min 'adhabi jahannam, wa min 'adhabil-qabr, wa min fitnatil-mahya wal-mamat, wa min sharri fitnatil-masihid-dajjal (O Allah! I seek refuge in You from the torment of Hell, from the torment of the grave, from the trials of life and death, and from the mischief of Al-Masih Ad-Dajjal (Antichrist)."

[Muslim].

- وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال‏:‏ ‏"‏إذا تشهد أحدكم فليستعذ بالله من أربع، يقول‏:‏ اللهم إني أعوذ بك من عذاب جهنم، ومن عذاب القبر ومن فتنة المحيا والممات، ومن شر فتنة المسيح الدجال‏"‏ ‏(‏‏(‏رواه مسلم‏)‏‏)‏‏.‏

Abu Hurairah (semoga Allah merahmatinya) melaporkan: Rasulullah (ﷺ) bersabda, "Apabila salah seorang daripada kamu telah selesai membaca Tahiyat semasa solat, hendaklah dia memohon perlindungan kepada Allah daripada empat perkara dan berkata: 'Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min 'adhabi jahannam, wa min 'adhabil-qabr, wa min fitnatil-mahya wal-mamat, wa min sharri fitnatil-masihid-dajjal' (Ya Allah! Sesungguhnya aku memohon perlindungan kepada-Mu daripada azab neraka, daripada azab kubur, daripada fitnah kehidupan dan kematian, dan daripada kejahatan fitnah Al-Masih Ad-Dajjal)." [Muslim].
